fact: WHO's report on its 2024-2025 cooperation, dated December 2025, states that the National Digital Health Strategy 2024-2028 was finalised and published as the strategic framework for modernising the Health Information System, and that an assessment of the Health Information System (SIS) found it 55% mature; the same report elsewhere prints the strategy's span as 2024-2034.
title: Results of Technical Cooperation: WHO in Cabo Verde 2024-2025
publisher: World Health Organization - WHO | Representation in Cabo Verde
